top_signals.title: Ukraine Tycoon Murder Plot Confounds Monaco Authorities
top_signals.summary: The attempted murder of Ukrainian tycoon Vadym Yermolaiev in Monaco earlier this year remains a mystery. The 58-year-old was walking home after dinner at a waterfront restaurant with his partner Anna Nasobina and their teenage son when a bomb was detonated on the steps of his residence. Bloomberg's Stephanie Baker explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
